title: Apps
error: Something went wrong with that app.

manage.title: Apps
manage.description: Apps add something the whole community shares. Only the community's superadmin can add or remove them.
manage.removeBody: What it created moves to the trash, where it can still be restored. Every credential it held — the community's and each member's — is deleted, and the app is told to stop using them.
manage.unavailable: Not set up on this server
manage.autoUpdateHelp: New versions from the publisher are applied on their own. Turn this off to read each one first and update by hand.
manage.autoUpdateOff: Updates are now applied by hand.

updates.declined: You declined version {{version}}. The app stays on its current version.
updates.moved: A different version is now available. Review what it asks for.

install.title: Add {{name}}
install.description: This adds something for the whole community. You can rename it now or later.
install.name: Name
install.adminOnly: Ask your community's superadmin to add this app.
install.unknownState: Could not check whether this app is already added.
install.reachNone: This app asks for no access to your community's content.
install.whereDescription: It shows its page, and reads and changes things, only in the initiatives you choose.
install.whereDescriptionNoPage: It reads and changes things only in the initiatives you choose.

connections.none: This app asks for nothing to be set up.
connections.memberSet: A community admin has set this up.
connections.memberNotSet: A community admin still has to set this up.
connections.guildFlowExplainer: This one is granted at the vendor rather than typed. Connecting opens their install page, where you choose the account and what this app may see.
connections.personalExplainer: This one signs you in as yourself, so each member connects their own account. Nobody else sees yours.
connections.connectOpened: Finish connecting in the tab that just opened.
connections.connectUnavailable: This app isn't set up on this server yet, so there's nowhere to sign in.
connections.blocked: A community admin has stopped you connecting this.
connections.expired: This connection has run out. Connect again to keep using it.

members.title: Members
members.noPersonal: This app has nothing members connect to individually.
members.revokeAllBody: Every member's stored credential is deleted and the app is told to stop using it. The app stays installed and keeps its community settings. Members can connect again afterwards.

consent.title: What it has asked to do as you
consent.description: {{name}} asks for each purpose on its own. Allow only what you're happy for it to do in your name. You can change your answer at any time.
consent.askedReadWrite: Asked to read and make changes
consent.statusReadWrite: Can read and change as you
consent.allowReadWrite: Let it read and change things as me
consent.allowed: Saved. {{name}} can do this as you.
consent.declinedToast: Declined. {{name}} won't do this as you.
consent.withdrawnToast: {{name}} has stopped doing this as you.
consent.memberRevoked: The app has stopped acting as that member.
consent.revokeAllTitle: Stop this app acting as everyone?
consent.revokeAllBody: The app stops making requests in any member's name at once. It stays installed and keeps its settings, and members can allow it again themselves.
consent.revokedAll: The app has stopped acting as everyone.

settings.description: Set up how this app connects.
settings.adminDescription: What the community owns for this app. Only the superadmin sees this.

embed.handoffFailed: Could not open this app. Try again in a moment.
embed.failed: This app could not be opened
embed.unavailable: {{name}} is not set up on this server
embed.unavailableDescription: Whoever runs this server needs to connect this app's service before it can be opened.
embed.noSurface: {{name}} has no page of its own

placement.title: Where this app works
placement.description: This app shows its page, and reads and changes things, only in the initiatives you choose.
placement.descriptionNoPage: This app reads and changes things only in the initiatives you choose.
placement.none: No initiatives chosen, so this app reaches nothing inside initiatives.

roles.title: Who can open it here
roles.adminsAlways: Community admins can always open it.

connected.title: Connected
connected.body: Your account is linked. Initiative recorded it, so the app's tiles will start answering for you.

refused.title: Not connected
refused.body: The other service did not complete the sign-in. Nothing changed here — try again from the app's settings.

expired.title: That link has expired
expired.body: Connect links are short-lived. Start again from the app's settings.

not_recorded.title: Nearly there
not_recorded.body: The other service signed you in, but Initiative did not record it. Connect again from the app's settings — nothing was lost.

awaiting_approval.title: Waiting on an owner
awaiting_approval.body: The other service asked somebody who owns that organization to approve this app. Nothing went wrong and nothing is set up yet — once they approve it, connect again from the app's settings.

sign_in_required.title: Sign in to finish
sign_in_required.body: Finish connecting in the browser where you're signed in to Initiative, as the person who started it.

scopes.title: What this app can reach
scopes.description: Choose what this app may read and change in this community.
scopes.error: Couldn't save what this app can reach.

sharing.write: See and change who has access to what
